name: fuji-cap-storm
js: v.weather.addStorm({ id: "t#0", x: 5, z: -70, radius: 6.5, top: 13.5, quiet: true }); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 1500)); for (let i = 0; i < 240 && v.clouds.cloudVariantPending; i++) await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 250)); return JSON.stringify({n: v.weather.storms.length, u: v.cloudUniforms.uStormCount.value, st: v.clouds.variantStatus})
